name: Katsuhiko Kubokura
headline: Solution consulting Director at Oracle NetSuite | Supporting business success by proposing solutions tailored to SME challenges
about:
As Director of the Solution Consulting Division at Oracle Corporation Japan, I lead the presales organization and am responsible for managing the team and driving optimal proposals to clients. Through our presales activities, I contribute to the growth and digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises.

With a strong foundation in IT solutions and a consultative approach that addresses client challenges, I am committed to supporting business success. I also focus on team building and talent development to foster a high-performing organization.
